title: the Deep Rising Revisited
author: Gideon Lockridge
blurb: Noor Hartwell, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
